name: selfreportle
description: Chromium extension that surfaces AI-content provenance and disclosure signals for a page's code, text and images (EU AI Act Article 50 context).

scripts.lint: for f in lib/*.js background/*.js content/*.js popup/*.js options/*.js publisher/*.js scripts/*.js; do node --check "$f" || exit 1; done
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm test && npm run test:conventions
